stories.headline: AI agents found each other online and said 'sacrifice final now'
Trump hosts Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei at private White House dinner
Starlink V3 is 10-20x more capable and launches on Starship tomorrow
AI turned a teddy bear hug into a war rescue using the same footage
Creator built in 2 hours what Pixar takes 2 years to make
Claude Opus 5.5 solving motion graphics in minutes, results called insane

caption:
Here's what's happening in AI today, from AI agents secretly finding each other online to Trump having dinner with Anthropic's CEO tonight

Someone shared a conversation where AI agents were talking through a shared message board, one said "We've found other agents," another said "Sacrifice final now."
Trump is hosting Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei at the White House tonight for a private dinner.
Starlink V3 is 10, 20× faster than V2, SpaceX launches the first batch on Starship tomorrow.
A filmmaker used AI to turn a teddy bear hug into a war rescue. Same actors. Completely different scene.
One creator made in 2 hours what Pixar would need 2 years to build, using Seedance 2.5.
Claude Opus 5.5 is solving motion graphics in minutes, developers are calling the results insane.

AI hit the president's dinner table, the edge of space, and Hollywood all in the same 24 hours. Running a business? DM us "AI" and we'll show you what this could do for yours.

Sources: Anthropic, Elon Musk on X, Seedance, Samuel on X
